items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: He's on that Pitch and Esquire book with Buddy Petit. Yeah, I know what you mean. Buddy Manatee.

ctx.x: Who was involved with the Blues band? Do you remember any of those guys?

Yeah, Amelia Barnes was in the band. Amelia Barnes, an old man played with a six-string banjo. Run over the lake and he died. He's on that Pitch and Esquire book with Buddy Petit. Yeah, I know what you mean. Buddy Manatee. And Israel, Israel Gorman. For years I could never get anybody to explain who he was, so I met him on the end of the union when I was there a few years back in the morning. He reminded me of George Lewis. I'd always tell Paul what happened to him. And he still acted. You ever seen him? Gabriel…
